title: Count recorded check results as commands that ran for D43 evidence
summary: In `judge` (crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs), commands the checks stage ran and recorded (fmt, clippy, test) are added to the commands counted as seen running. A behavior criterion that cites them is then evidenced by the recorded results and no longer rejected under D43. The audience is the verifier and Athena maintainers, who stop losing retries to this finding.

defaults_applied.how: Unit tests added; cargo test, clippy and fmt must pass.
Criteria check that judge's behavior changes, via tests.
Fixes the matcher's set of known-ran commands, not individual jobs.
One function change plus a decision record.
A decision entry explains the change for outside readers.
Enforced in judge code, not in prose.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Chosen fix: make the recorded check results count as ran commands, rather than telling producers not to write such criteria. This matches the request's first alternative, and it is mechanism, not prose.
The checks stage runs in the verifier's snapshot, so its recorded commands are real evidence of execution.
CheckRun.command (a Vec<String> argv) is joined with spaces to compare against cited commands.
The verifier prompt or producer brief may get a one-line note; this is optional.

acceptance_criteria.text: A unit test in verify.rs shows `judge` treats a behavior criterion citing `cargo test`, `cargo clippy` or `cargo fmt --check` as verified when the matching recorded check run has that command, even if the verifier's own commands_run is empty. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.

A unit test shows a cited command that is neither in commands_run nor in the recorded checks (for example `cargo test --all` when the check ran `cargo test`) is still unseen and yields the 'cited but not seen running' finding. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
A failed recorded check still fails the verdict (reason 'check ... failed') and does not count as evidence that the criterion is met. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
`cargo test` passes for the workspace and `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean.

A new decision in docs/decisions.md amends D43, with alternatives, tradeoff, reversal cost and provenance (the m988 and txka rejections, labeled as reported by the user). It is linked in docs/decision-links.toml if that file's convention requires it, and CHANGELOG.md notes the change.
The check command's argv is matched with the same simple-command normalization as D63, and the existing D43 and D63 tests still pass unchanged.

out_of_scope: Loosening D43 for commands that never ran
Changing which checks the checks stage runs
